title: Cumberland Cottage * Hot Tub * Fire Pit * Opry
description:
The Cumberland Cottage is a stunning 1930s restoration, eclectically furnished and bursting with high-end details like a chef's kitchen, king master suite, well appointed 2nd and 3rd bedrooms, and dedicated parking. There's also an incredible outdoor oasis, with total privacy for your hot tub enjoyment, a gas fire pit, and sparkling lights overhead.

The Cottage is close to all the action of Nashville, but tucked away on a quiet residential street. It's the perfect base for your adventure!

The space
We hope you enjoy our home as much as we do! 
 
Whatever the reason for your Nashville visit, it is our goal to ensure you have a memorable experience at The Cumberland Cottage.
 
Amenities
- Outdoor space
- Luxury linens and bath items
- Spacious closets in every bedrooms
- Chef's kitchen with gourmet appliances and cookware
- Keurig with complimentary coffee and sweetener
- Shampoo, conditioner, and body wash provided in each shower
- Blow dryers
- High speed Xfinity internet
- Keypad entry with custom code for each guest
- Private off street parking for two guests in front of the home

Guest access
As our guests you'll have access to the entire home. Please note, there is a second home located in the rear of the property. This home has a separate entrance, with a tall fence in place to create total privacy between the homes.

Other things to note
Enjoy our lightning fast high speed internet service, perfect for streaming the free YouTube TV with DVR, your own Netflix/Amazon/Disney+ account, or using Zoom for work.
